item.title: Write an Editor’s Note for a Reconstructed Recipe
item.prompt_text: An inherited cake recipe names several ingredients but gives no quantities for flour or milk. Two descendants remember different amounts, and one says the mixture was judged by feel. Your group has tested a version that works in a standard tin. Write a note accompanying the recipe that distinguishes the original record, oral accounts and editorial decisions. Give readers practical guidance without presenting the tested version as the only authentic one.
item.target_grammar: Careful attribution, concession, conditional guidance and parallel distinctions.
item.target_structure: Identify the source evidence, compare memories with the test, and explain how readers should use the edited recipe.

checklist.point: State what the original record gives and what it omits.
Represent the memories without treating one as settled fact.
Make the origin of the printed quantities explicit.
Give readers usable guidance while preserving uncertainty.
